spec2def(wmiutils.dll wmiutils.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(wmiutils registry wmiutils_classes.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# wmiutils.dll is all Rust (wmiutils-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wmiutils-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wmiutils-rust/src/wmiutils/main.rs)
# path.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wmiutils-rust/src/wmiutils/path.rs)
# statuscode.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wmiutils-rust/src/wmiutils/statuscode.rs)
set(WMIUTILS_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/wmiutils/wmiutils_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(wmiutils wmiutils-cargo wmiutils.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE wmiutils-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/wbem
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wmiutils_r ${WMIUTILS_REUSED} psdk)
